Package model

Class ListOfPlaylists

java.lang.Object
model.ListOfPlaylists
All Implemented Interfaces:
Storable
public class ListOfPlaylists extends Object implements Storable
The ListOfPlaylists class contains a collection of Playlist objects. It provides methods to load, view, create, and manage playlists, as well as handle file operations.

    • ListOfPlaylists

      public ListOfPlaylists()
      Default constructor. Initializes the username as "Stranger" and an empty list of playlists if no arguments provided by the user at the beginning.

    • ListOfPlaylists

      public ListOfPlaylists(String userName, String playlistFilePath, FileHandler fileHandler)
      Constructor that initializes a ListOfPlaylists with the provided username, file path, and file handler.
      Parameters:
      userName - The username associated with the list of playlists.
      playlistFilePath - The file path where the playlists data is stored.
      fileHandler - The file handler to manage file operations.

  • Method Details

    • loadFromFile

      public void loadFromFile() throws InvalidLineException
      Loads each playlist data which is a single line from the file. This method also call the function of Playlist class to load the media content for each playlist from their respective files.
      Specified by:
      loadFromFile in interface Storable
      Throws:
      InvalidLineException - If the data format in the file is invalid.

    • viewAllPlaylist

      public void viewAllPlaylist()
      Displays all playlists in a formatted list. If no playlists are found, a message is printed indicating the absence of playlists.

    • createNewPlaylist

      public void createNewPlaylist() throws InvalidFormatException, PlaylistFullException
      Prompts the user to create a new playlist by entering its name, type, and filename.
      Throws:
      InvalidFormatException - If the playlist type is not valid.
      PlaylistFullException - If the playlist exceeds the maximum capacity.

    • removePlaylist

      public void removePlaylist(Playlist<? extends Media> playlist)
      Removes a playlist from the list of playlists.
      Parameters:
      playlist - The Playlist object to be removed.

    • writeBack

      public void writeBack() throws FileNotFoundException
      Writes the playlist data back to the file. Each playlist is saved to its respective file, and the overall playlist data is saved to the specified path.
      Specified by:
      writeBack in interface Storable
      Throws:
      FileNotFoundException - If the file to write to is not found.
